overview_description.description:
Network International provider of payment solutions in the Middle East. Network International is well-equipped to meet the growing needs of its customers, making payment transactions secure, fast and easy for banks, financial institutions, retailers and their customers. 

Established in 1994, Network International has grown to become the region’s most innovative payment solutions provider. Be it credit and debit card processing, ATM management and monitoring, merchant acquiring or consumer finance applications, Network International offers a range of innovative products and services that can be tailored to your specific needs. In addition, Network International provides consultancy services to plan, design and prepare any new card product or programme.

A principal member of both Visa International and MasterCard International for the UAE, Network International is the first independent vendor to be certified by both Visa and MasterCard for card payments - a significant feat for any payment solutions provider in the Middle East. 

As Network International continues its growth trajectory, the company takes pride in delivering solutions that drive customer revenue and profitability.

about_short_description.short_description: Network International is a provider for payment solutions.

product.name: Merchant Acquiring Solutions
product.description: Payment acceptance services for businesses across in-person, online, remote and mobile channels, including transaction processing, settlement and merchant support.

product.name: N-Genius Online
product.description: An online payment gateway for accepting digital payments through secure checkout pages, APIs, SDKs, payment links and e-commerce platform integrations.

product.name: N-Genius POS and In-Person Payments
product.description: Point-of-sale payment acceptance using N-Genius terminals, integrated payment applications and SoftPOS on compatible iPhone, Android and tablet devices.

product.name: Payment Processing Solutions
product.description: End-to-end transaction processing infrastructure for banks, fintechs, telcos, issuers and acquirers, covering card, account and payment-device operations.

product.name: Card and Digital Wallet Processing
product.description: Issuing and processing services for credit, debit and prepaid cards, digital wallets and associated cardholder transactions.

product.name: Business Payment Solutions
product.description: Corporate and commercial payment products that combine card or digital payment capabilities with expense controls, travel payments and financial data integration.
